presentation.label: Tempo LED marks the bar
presentation.summary: The tempo LED flashes green on the 1 of every bar while the sequencer plays; the other beats stay red.
presentation.overview: A visual downbeat for players who can't use the click track, for example when the cue outputs feed external effects. While the sequencer plays, the tempo LED flashes green on beat 1 of every four-beat bar, counted from PLAY, and red on beats 2, 3 and 4 as stock does. Stopped, it is stock. Nothing to set: install it and press PLAY.
highlights: Green on the 1, stock red on the other beats.
Follows the project tempo, external MIDI clock and tempo changes: it counts stock's own beat flash.
No menu, no knob, no project data: remove the module and the LED is stock again.
usage: Press [PLAY]: the first flash is green, then three red flashes, then green again on the next bar.
Change the tempo or follow external MIDI clock: the green stays on every fourth beat.
Press [STOP]: the LED behaves as stock, and the next [PLAY] starts on the 1 again.

access.location: The tempo LED, while the sequencer plays
steps: Press [PLAY]: the first flash is green, then three red flashes, then green again on the next bar.
Change the tempo or follow external MIDI clock: the green stays on every fourth beat.
Press [STOP]: the LED behaves as stock, and the next [PLAY] starts on the 1 again.

limitations: OS 1.40C. The bar is four beats counted from [PLAY], not the pattern's own length: a pattern whose length is not a whole number of four-beat bars wraps out of step with the green flash.
Green is LED id 39, the pair of stock's red 38 by the panel's red/green numbering; confirmed in the emulator's calls, not yet seen on a unit.
Pausing ([PLAY] while playing) and continuing are not yet tested.

storage.label: ColdFire code and state
storage.conditions: One linked unit: 56 bytes of code and one 4-byte beat counter; the USB package is 192 bytes. One six-byte detour. No DSP memory.

processing.label: ColdFire, once per beat
processing.conditions: At most 12 instructions before stock's set_led, once per beat (24 clock ticks), in stock's clock-message loop. Nothing per sample or per frame.

impact.conditions: Once per beat in stock's clock-message loop.

cpu.rationale: At most 12 ColdFire instructions once per beat.

tests.summary: ot_emu on stock 1.40C (2 November 2026): with the unit preloaded and the call redirected, 11 beats after the transport start call set_led with id 39 on beats 1, 5 and 9 and stock's 38 on the others; stock alone calls 38 on every beat and none while stopped. Not yet run on a unit.
